Open Artifact

English · 简体中文 · 日本語

 Formerly baoyu-design . This project started as
 baoyu-design (the old URL redirects here), which brought claude.ai-style
 Artifact types to local coding agents as one skill per type. Open Artifact rebuilds them as an open, agent-agnostic
 format: one local daemon, one page frame, one /open-artifact skill, and a plugin for each agent app.

 Open Artifact lets any coding agent make things people can open, edit and comment on, not just files. You ask
your agent for a slide deck, a UI design, a design system, a whiteboard, a spreadsheet, a data dashboard, a doc or a short animated film. The agent writes a plain folder of files.
A local page opens it in a real editor, where you can fix a title, move a sticky note, leave comments, and export. Then
"Send to agent" sends your comments back to the agent's session.

 

Everything runs on your machine. No account, no upload, no specific model or vendor.

 

 Documentation

Start in docs/ for full bilingual (English / 中文) guides for both users and AI agents:

- What is Open Artifact? — Core concept, key advantages, and quick start.
- Artifact types overview — Compare all 8 types, how to choose, and storage models.
- How agents use Open Artifact — MCP tools, CLI fallback, workflow lifecycle, comments, and safety rules.

 Building an agent product?

If you ship an agent app (desktop, IDE extension, command line, or a web app with a local helper), you can make Open
Artifact part of it: your agent makes artifacts through its own tools, the pages show in your UI, and the comments
people send from a page arrive in the right session. Start at
Integrating Open Artifact into an agent product; the Node SDK is
 @open-artifact/harness-kit , and examples/ has runnable
adapters. Apps not written in JavaScript use the stdio bridge ( open-artifact harness --stdio ).

 Artifact types

 Type What you get Folder marker Exports Guides 
 --- --- --- --- --- 
 Slides A 1920×1080 (or 4:3) deck: slide rail, overview, speaker notes, builds, transitions, presenter mode project/deck.json PDF, PPTX, HTML, PNG Guide · SKILL 
 Design An infinite canvas of live .dc.html artboards: screens, components, click-through prototypes, notes, pages project/canvas.json PNG, JPEG, PDF, HTML Guide · SKILL 
 Design System A brand book: tokens, colors with contrast checks, type specimens, live component previews, assets. Designs, decks, dashboards, and films can install it project/design-system.json — Guide · SKILL 
 Whiteboard A shared infinite board: stickies, shapes, arrows, ink, images, tables, embeds, live cursors, timer db/board/meta.json PNG Guide · SKILL 
 Sheets A shared spreadsheet: several sheets of cells, a full formula engine, number formats, borders, merged cells, tables with filters, dropdowns, checkboxes, conditional formats, frozen and grouped rows, charts from cells, CSV import, cell history sheet/sheet.json XLSX, CSV Guide · SKILL 
 Data A live dashboard or report: datasets from CSV/JSON/text uploads, live MCP connector queries or calculations, drawn by a plain HTML/CSS/d3 page; Sources shows where each number comes from; filters, hand edits, remix drafts db/dash/meta.json PDF, HTML, JSON Guide · SKILL 
 Docs A living document in tabs: headings, lists, tables, pictures, dates, mentions and dropdowns; suggested edits to accept or reject, comments, a version history per tab; imports Markdown, Word and PDF doc/doc.json Markdown, Word, PDF, HTML Guide · SKILL 
 Motion A short animated film: scenes in HTML/CSS/JS drawn from time, a generated score, rough cut then final, captions and voiceover; retype, recolor, refont, recut and restyle by hand; comments pinned to a moment or a spot in the frame db/film/meta.json MP4, GIF, HTML, ZIP Guide · SKILL 

Each type folder is a self-contained skill: SKILL.md tells the agent how to write it, reference/ documents the
file format, artifact-type.json describes it to hosts, and scripts/ (built) holds the CLI and editors.

 Quick start

 1. As a plugin in your agent app (recommended)

Install Node.js 22.18+ , then download open-artifact-plugins.zip from the Assets section of a
GitHub Release. Extract it to a permanent location and use the
extracted open-artifact-plugins/ folder in the steps below. The plugins include the skill, daemon and editors.
DeepSeek Harness installs its prebuilt package directly from npm.

 Agent app Install 
 --- --- 
 Claude Code (CLI, desktop, IDE) Add the extracted root as a marketplace, then install open-artifact@open-artifact . 
 Codex (CLI, app) and ChatGPT desktop Add the extracted root with codex plugin marketplace add , then install Open Artifact in Plugins. 
 Cursor Copy the extracted cursor/ folder to /.cursor/plugins/local/open-artifact , then run Developer: Reload Window . 
 GitHub Copilot CLI Add the extracted root as a marketplace, then install open-artifact@open-artifact . 
 GitHub Copilot in VS Code Run Chat: Install Plugin from Source and select the extracted copilot/ folder. 
 Antigravity Install the extracted antigravity/ folder with agy plugin install or copy it to /.gemini/config/plugins/open-artifact , then restart the app. 
 ZCode In Plugin Marketplace, add the extracted zcode/ folder as a plugin marketplace, then install Open Artifact from the listing. 
 ChatGPT on the web Run the prebuilt connector from the extracted chatgpt/ folder and connect it over HTTPS. 
 DeepSeek Harness In Plugins, choose Add plugin and enter dsh-open-artifact as the npm package. In the CLI, run dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-open-artifact for the web profile.

update steps in the linked guide. If your marketplace still points to a source checkout, register the extracted
folder using the migration steps in your app's guide.

  you ──"/open-artifact slides a 6-slide pitch"──▶ agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, …)
                                                     │ writes files

install.title: Quick start
install.html:
1. As a plugin in your agent app (recommended)

Install Node.js 22.18+, then download open-artifact-plugins.zip from the Assets section of a GitHub Release. Extract it to a permanent location and use the extracted open-artifact-plugins/ folder in the steps below. The plugins include the skill, daemon and editors. DeepSeek Harness installs its prebuilt package directly from npm.

Agent app Install
Claude Code (CLI, desktop, IDE) Add the extracted root as a marketplace, then install open-artifact@open-artifact.
Codex (CLI, app) and ChatGPT desktop Add the extracted root with codex plugin marketplace add, then install Open Artifact in Plugins.
Cursor Copy the extracted cursor/ folder to ~/.cursor/plugins/local/open-artifact, then run Developer: Reload Window.
GitHub Copilot CLI Add the extracted root as a marketplace, then install open-artifact@open-artifact.
GitHub Copilot in VS Code Run Chat: Install Plugin from Source and select the extracted copilot/ folder.
Antigravity Install the extracted antigravity/ folder with agy plugin install or copy it to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/open-artifact, then restart the app.
ZCode In Plugin Marketplace, add the extracted zcode/ folder as a plugin marketplace, then install Open Artifact from the listing.
ChatGPT on the web Run the prebuilt connector from the extracted chatgpt/ folder and connect it over HTTPS.
DeepSeek Harness In Plugins, choose Add plugin and enter dsh-open-artifact as the npm package. In the CLI, run dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-open-artifact for the web profile.

To upgrade, download the new ZIP, replace the extracted folder at the same path, and follow your app's update steps in the linked guide. If your marketplace still points to a source checkout, register the extracted folder using the migration steps in your app's guide.

In DeepSeek Harness, use Update on the Open Artifact page when a new version is offered. If you previously linked a local checkout, remove the linked plugin in Plugins and add dsh-open-artifact from npm.

In a new session, try one of these prompts.

/open-artifact slides a 6-slide pitch for this repo
/open-artifact design three landing page options for a coffee shop
/open-artifact whiteboard a retro board for last sprint
/open-artifact sheets a monthly budget with categories and totals
/open-artifact data a dashboard of signups by month from signups.csv
/open-artifact docs a hiring plan for 2027 with roles, budget and timeline
/open-artifact motion a 20-second launch animation for this app

The plugin adds the Artifact, ArtifactData and ArtifactComments MCP tools, the skill, and hooks that bring page comments back into the session. How each app gets comments back, and what was tested in each, is in plugins/README.md.

In an app that shows MCP Apps, the agent also gets a ShowArtifact tool: it puts the artifact's live page in the conversation, where you can edit and comment without leaving the chat, go full screen, open it in a browser or send your comments to the agent. Apps that don't show MCP Apps never see the tool.

2. As a skill for any other agent

Copy codex/skills/open-artifact/ from the extracted plugin bundle to your agent's skill directory. It carries the daemon, and the agent drives it from the command line. From the extracted bundle root, you can try:

node codex/skills/open-artifact/scripts/open-artifact.mjs artifact '{"action":"list","scope":"types"}'
3. One type on its own

After building from source, every built type folder runs by itself, without the daemon:

node artifact-types/design/scripts/cli.mjs open ./my-design --type design   # starts a local server, prints the URL
node artifact-types/design/scripts/cli.mjs wait ./my-design                 # blocks until someone presses "Send to agent"

Other commands: check, generate, upload, context, comments, history, share, status, stop, … Run the CLI with no arguments for the full list.
